approval: User explicitly approved the causal 30-day temporal forecast protocol.
interval_censoring: An anchor is retained as positive only when its 30-day horizon fully contains the published event interval. Partial overlaps are excluded.

optical.causal_rule: Only Sentinel-2 acquisitions on or before the anchor date.
optical.missing_fill: Train-only median of per-node valid-pixel medians.

release_scope.dispersion: sample standard deviation across optimization seeds
release_scope.excluded_evidence: separate 125-scene rerun is not pooled, substituted, or cited as confirmation
release_scope.test_interpretation: nine correlated anchors from one 2022 drainage sequence

target.primary: At observed event-footprint node(s), will a GLOF/drainage event occur within the next 30 days?
target.primary_loss_mask: Only observed event-footprint node(s) are temporally supervised.
target.secondary: Full-grid spatial localization labels are stored only on positive anchors and are not primary BCE training targets.
target.trajectory: Six future 8-day bins with interval-censor masks.

thermal.causal_rule: Four latest aligned MODIS slots on or before the anchor date.

velocity.causal_rule: Completed annual mosaics y-4 through y-1; event-year velocity is excluded.
velocity.graph_flow: Causal mean direction from the same historical velocity sequence.
